_comment: Static snapshot of 3rd-party library CVEs used by the Trailmark PoC. Keys are full Java import prefixes.

org.apache.logging.log4j.name: Log4Shell
org.apache.logging.log4j.description: A JNDI injection vulnerability in log4j-core allows unauthenticated remote code execution when a user-controlled string is logged.
org.apache.logging.log4j.remediation: Upgrade log4j-core to 2.17.1 or later. If upgrading is not possible, set log4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true or remove the JndiLookup class from the classpath.

org.apache.logging.log4j.name: Log4Shell bypass
org.apache.logging.log4j.description: Incomplete fix for CVE-2021-44228 allows information disclosure and remote code execution via specially crafted lookup strings.

org.apache.commons.text.name: Text4Shell
org.apache.commons.text.description: Apache Commons Text's StringSubstitutor interpolates script://, dns://, and url:// lookup expressions in user-controlled strings, enabling remote code execution.

com.fasterxml.jackson.name: Jackson Databind Resource Exhaustion
com.fasterxml.jackson.description: Deep nesting of arrays/objects in WRAP_OBJECT_VALUE_AS_ARRAY deserialization mode can cause stack overflow / denial of service.

com.fasterxml.jackson.name: Jackson Databind Resource Exhaustion (2)
com.fasterxml.jackson.description: BeanDeserializer WITH_COERCION_CONFIG can be abused with crafted JSON to cause stack overflow / denial of service.

org.springframework.name: Spring4Shell
org.springframework.description: A Spring MVC or Spring WebFlux application running on JDK 9+ may be vulnerable to remote code execution via data binding.
org.springframework.remediation: Upgrade to Spring Framework 5.3.18+ or Spring Boot 2.6.6+. Apply WAF rules blocking 'class.*', 'Class.*', '*.class.*', '*.Class.*' parameter patterns.
